mapper.sql: club_id, name, category_id, description, charter, founder_id, status, created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT c.club_id AS clubId, c.name, c.description, c.created_at AS createdAt, cc.name AS categoryName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_member cm WHERE cm.club_id = c.club_id AND cm.join_status = '2' ) AS memberCount FROM club c LEFT JOIN club_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.category_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND c.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club (name, category_id, description, charter, founder_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, #{charter}, #{founderId}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT c.* FROM club c INNER JOIN club_member cm ON c.club_id = cm.club_id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.join_status = '2' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.*, u.name as founder_name, u.email as founder_email, u.student_no as founder_student_no, cc.name as category_name FROM club c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.founder_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN club_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.category_id WHERE c.club_id = #{clubId}
